deadlines.label: Fall 2027 completed application
deadlines.note: Department admissions page says December2,2026; current SOM table and September2026 PDF say December3. Use earlier date and confirm directly. All components required by closing date; no time stated.

english.note: TOEFL/IELTS for nonnative international applicants, received by deadline. U.S. degree completed or due before matriculation waives TOEFL; no numeric minimum in program PDF. English application materials; WES approved for international transcripts.

applicationFee.note: 2026–2027 application fee covers up to four listed SOM PhD applications. Income waiver US citizens/PR only; military and qualifying alumni categories. Non-US applicants meeting alumni category may request with supporting evidence; no general international hardship waiver.

documents: Two-page maximum statement: one page research/career goals, one formative experience
requirements.note: Rotations across disciplines; no programmatic area commitment needed at admission. Accepted students undergo background check and provide official transcripts.

funding.note: SOM PhD support guaranteed subject to collective bargaining agreement; tuition and eligible student health benefits. Minimum $52,000 for 2026–2027, not a Fall 2027 rate.

sources.label: Department admissions: earlier conflicting deadline and current requirements

timeline.interviews: Interview invitations mid-to-late December; virtual interviews January 14–16, 2027 (PDF inconsistently calls this the 2026 recruitment season).
